payload.title: Feeding records: a negative amount is accepted and mints phantom stock, lowering an amount returns the stock but keeps the cost, and an edit never re-prices the record, the batch cost or the finance expense
payload.rule_violated: A ledger movement is validated at the boundary (a quantity is positive) and a correction moves stock, cost and the finance expense by the same delta
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Confirmed live on a ZZ-AUDIT chain (cleaned up): a record edited to a negative amount was accepted and the summary summed it. updateFeedingRecord forwards no feedCost, so costDiff in the handler is always 0. Fix: validate amount > 0 in the DTO and the handler; recompute feedCost from the delta (same rule as recordFeed) and adjust Batch.totalFeedCost; exclude voided rows from aggregates.
